package validators

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPHPValidatorOriginRouteAndMapping(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Path != "/api/v1/validate/syntax" || r.Method != http.MethodPost || r.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
			t.Errorf("unexpected request: %s %s", r.Method, r.URL)
		}
		var payload map[string]string
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(payload) != 1 || payload["code"] != "<?php invalid" {
			t.Errorf("unexpected payload: %#v", payload)
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"ok":false,"errors":[{"code":"SYNTAX_ERROR","message":"invalid","line":2,"column":3}]}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	validator := NewPHPValidator(server.URL)
	result, err := validator.ValidateAll(context.Background(), "ignored", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.php", Content: "<?php invalid"}, {Path: "second.php", Content: "ignored"}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Valid || len(result.Errors) != 1 || result.Errors[0].File != "index.php" || result.Errors[0].Line != 2 || result.Errors[0].Column != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %#v", result)
	}
}

func TestPHPValidatorRejectsNonOriginConfiguration(t *testing.T) {
	for _, origin := range []string{"http://localhost/api/v1", "http://localhost/", "http://localhost?x=1", "http://localhost?", "http://localhost#fragment", "http://localhost#", "http://user:pass@localhost", "localhost:8090", "ftp://localhost", "http://", " http://localhost"} {
		t.Run(origin, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := NewPHPValidator(origin).ValidateAll(context.Background(), "task", nil)
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "must be an HTTP(S) origin") {
				t.Fatalf("expected origin error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
	_, err := NewPHPValidator("").ValidateAll(context.Background(), "task", nil)
	if err == nil || err.Error() != "php validator url is empty" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected empty error: %v", err)
	}
	result, err := NewPHPValidator("https://localhost:8090").ValidateAll(context.Background(), "task", nil)
	if err != nil || result.Valid || result.Errors[0].Code != "NO_PHP_FILE" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected no-file result: %#v, %v", result, err)
	}
}
